listing.headline: Furnished 3-Bedroom Home in Southwest Bend with Yard Care Included
listing.description:
Enjoy comfort, convenience, and Bend living in this well-kept furnished 3-bedroom, 2-bath home located on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Southwest Bend.

The home features a charming covered front porch, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. Inside, you’re welcomed into a bright dining and living area with an easy, comfortable layout. To the left, you’ll find a fully equipped kitchen with everything you need for everyday living.

Just beyond the living room, sliding glass doors open to a spacious backyard with a large deck and string lights, creating a great setting for relaxing or entertaining. The fully fenced backyard offers plenty of room for approved pets or kids to enjoy, and yard maintenance is included.

All bedrooms are generously sized. The primary suite includes a large bathroom with a double vanity, while the room with twin beds can be easily converted into an office, bonus room, or guest space.

Additional features include central heating and air conditioning, a laundry room, and a two-car garage.

This home offers a great Southwest Bend location close to shopping, dining, parks, trails, and everything Bend has to offer.

Lease Terms:
Minimum stay of 90 days, with lease options up to 11 months. Tenant is responsible for utilities. An all-inclusive utility option is available for an additional monthly rate.

Pets are allowed with approval and an additional $400 deposit per pet, up to 2 pets.

Please inquire to learn more or schedule a showing. Must meet minimum standards to see a 660 score and 2.5 X rent in income.

listing.headline: Beautiful 3-Bedroom Home Above Miller’s Landing with River and Mountain Vistas
listing.description:
Experience true Bend living in this beautifully designed, single-level custom home perched above Miller’s Landing. The property offers scenic river vistas, peekaboo views of Mt. Bachelor, and an exceptional outdoor living space—all within walking distance of downtown Bend, the Old Mill District, Drake Park, and the Deschutes River rapids.

Landscaping is included. Tenant only pays trash, internet and electric, which the house has solar so the electric bill will be minimal.

The highlight of the home is the spacious covered patio, which opens to the yard and a circular fire pit area overlooking the river. Large Loewen windows and sliding doors bring the surrounding scenery into the home and provide seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Inside, the inviting living room features a cozy fireplace and flows into a bright dining area surrounded by generous windows. The spacious kitchen includes a large island with breakfast-bar seating, stainless-steel appliances, and a walk-in pantry.

Wake up in your primary suite to views of the river and its own sliding door leading to the patio, along with a walk-in closet and a private bathroom featuring a double vanity, walk-in shower, and jetted soaking tub.

Additional features include:

Radiant heated floors throughout
Walking path down to Shasta for easy access to the river.  (Main Entrance from behind through the newly paved alley)
Bonus room with skylights above the garage, ideal for an office, media room, or hangout space
Laundry room with stacked washer and dryer, utility sink, cabinetry, and storage
Two-car garage
Additional driveway parking
Solar panels to help reduce electricity costs

The home shares a driveway with a separate ADU located on the property. 

Enjoy peaceful river scenery, thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces, and convenient access to some of Bend’s best parks, trails, restaurants, and attractions.
